summary: First end-to-end testing iteration for HackHive Schedule. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passing covering auth (admin login, register, /me, bad password), meetings CRUD, public poll, voting + dedup + tally, host-only finalize, host-only attendance, recording → completed status, ICS export with VCALENDAR, overlap detection (400), dashboard stats, notifications list/read-all, and auto-finalize. Frontend: landing page renders, admin login flow works (redirects to /dashboard), dashboard shows stats (Total Meetings, Active Polls, Finalized, Completed) and meeting cards correctly, Calendar/Notifications/Analytics pages load without errors. Create-meeting page route at /create did not render the form (form data-testid not visible — likely a different route path).

minor.issue: Schema only accepts meeting_type in {'group','private'} but problem statement and review request mentioned 'team'. Either docs or schema should be aligned.
Returns keys total_meetings/active_polls/finalized_meetings/completed_meetings/attendance — review request expected total/voting/finalized/completed; minor naming mismatch but data is present.
AttendanceIn requires status: Literal['attended','missed'] (not boolean attended). Review request said attended/missed boolean — confirm contract.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /create did not render the create-meeting-form (data-testid not visible). Verify the actual route path in App.js (may be /meetings/new or similar) and either align route or add /create alias.

action_items: Confirm/document route path for CreateMeeting page (test used /create which did not render the form).
Decide canonical contract for attendance: status enum vs attended boolean — update either backend or review-request docs.
Decide canonical meeting_type values (group/private vs team) and align with docs/UI options.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 569 lines and mixes auth, meetings, notifications, dashboard, ICS, auto-finalize. Consider splitting into routers (auth.py, meetings.py, notifications.py) once growth continues.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" in backend/.env is permissive; with httpOnly samesite=none cookies, prefer explicit origin allow-list (FRONTEND_URL) for credentialed CORS to avoid browser blocking on some configurations.
auto-finalize is open to any authenticated user — acceptable per spec, but add rate-limiting / idempotency guard so it cannot be abused to spam notifications.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (login, dashboard, calendar, notifications, analytics OK; create-meeting route not verified)

test_credentials: admin@hackhive.dev / admin123 (verified). Participant users registered dynamically via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed meetings (Meeting/Overlap1/Overlap2/Auto). They remain in DB; backend has no bulk-cleanup endpoint. Did not pollute admin dashboard significantly (8 cards visible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://vote-sync-hub.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_hackhive.py — passes 18/18. AttendanceIn expects {user_id, status: 'attended'|'missed'}. MeetingCreate meeting_type must be 'group' or 'private'. Dashboard stats keys: total_meetings/active_polls/finalized_meetings/completed_meetings/attendance. Vote/auto-finalize: voting endpoint enforces deadline, so to test auto-finalize, set deadline a few seconds in the future, vote, sleep, then call /api/meetings/auto-finalize. Frontend Create-meeting route path needs verification — /create did not render the form.
